name: Meng Deng Hua
source:
Noctuary is a double-protagonist AVG game. Players can play the role of the duo, Fancia Dream and Alina Nightsong. Who have dreams of “becoming Arborangers,” “to protect and serve everyone.” The duo travel through the fairy-tale-like Inlixaland, explore their lively daily adventures, and gradually encounter the life story of a mysterious girl who came down from the sky.

Meanwhile, don't forget to fight against the omnipresent Darkritters of the Inlixaland! These dangerous monsters threaten the life of ordinary Illuminators constantly. Sharpen your fighting skills, defeat ferocious enemies, and ensure peace amongst your community!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143680/Noctuary/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Noctuary》是一款双主角AVG游戏。玩家可以扮演双人组Fancia Dream和Alina Nightsong的角色。他们梦想“成为Arborangers”，“保护和服务每个人”。两人穿越童话般的英利克萨乐园，探索他们热闹的日常冒险，并逐渐遇到一个从天而降的神秘女孩的人生故事。

与此同时，别忘了对抗因利克萨兰无所不在的黑暗生物！这些危险的怪物不断威胁着普通照明者的生命。磨练你的战斗技巧，击败凶猛的敌人，确保社区的和平！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143680/Noctuary/]Steam[/url]]
